title: test(dogfood): the census re-anchors rest-server.ts's enforceAuth control 61 -> 64 for three comment-only mentions
body:
Fixes #23563
Clause-②: no

The hourly full run's `Dogfood Regression Gate (3/3)` is red on `main` at `packages/qa/dogfood/test/authz-probe-blind-spot.test.ts:88`: `control "enforceAuth" moved in packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts: expected 64 to be 61`. This PR re-anchors that one control by the census's own rule for a moved positive control, with a provenance note. It does not drop, narrow or relax it.

## What changed

One file: `packages/qa/dogfood/test/authz-probe-blind-spot.census.ts`, on the `rest-server.ts` row only.

- `controls.enforceAuth`: `61` -> `64`. It stays an exact count, not a range or a floor.
- A provenance paragraph after the `[#23050 slice 1]` one, in the same voice as the earlier moves (`[commit cc837dbfe]` 61 -> 64, `[#20102]` 64 -> 56, `[#23050 slice 1]` 57 -> 61). It says the control was RE-ANCHORED, not relaxed, and names the three comment-only mentions by line.

Not touched: `packages/rest/**` (the comments #23541 added stay as written), the test runner, every other row and control, and the census's counting rule. The census states that `occurrences` counts the bare term, comments included. Its earlier moves were re-anchored under that rule, so this is a re-anchor, not a rule change.

## Measurements (H1 to H4 from the dispatch)

Every count below comes from the census's own `deriveProbeFileCensus()`, imported from the checkout named and run with `tsx`. None is a grep of my own.

**H1: only comments moved. Confirmed.**

| tree | `enforceAuth` (derived / recorded) |
|---|---|
| `8226755ee9` (last green hourly run; parent of `1d79556766`) | 61 / 61 |
| `1d79556766` (PR #23541, #23367) | 64 / 61 |
| `fa6a6085c` (this branch's base) | 64 / 61 |

`git show 1d79556766 -- packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts` adds exactly three lines that spell `enforceAuth` and removes none. `data-action-routes.ts`, the row's second file, is not in that commit. The three lines, at `fa6a6085c`:

- `rest-server.ts:2395`, docblock on `apiKeyLifecycleRefusals`: "by {@link computeExecCtx}'s catch so {@link enforceAuth} can answer it."
- `rest-server.ts:2397`, the same docblock: "identity fault: every door that never reaches `enforceAuth` keeps the"
- `rest-server.ts:3471`, an inline `//` comment in `computeExecCtx`'s outer `catch` (declared at `:3044`): "for `enforceAuth`, which answers its `403` and code."

All three are comments. The same commit also changed `enforceAuth`'s own body (the lifecycle-refusal answer) and its docblock, but none of those lines spells the term. It added no call site, forwarder or interface member. No commit between `8226755ee9` and `fa6a6085c` other than `1d79556766` touches either file the row reads.

**H2: nothing else on the row moved. Confirmed.** At `fa6a6085c`, `population` 70 / `reachable` 19 / `blindSpot` 51 match the record. So do the other six controls: `private register*Endpoints(` 16, `this.routeManager.register(` 63, `data-action-routes.ts: this.routeManager.register(` 9, `registerPerItemRoute(` 8, `const registerPerItemRoute =` 1, `forwarder slice: this.routeManager.register(` 1. Every other census row also reads as pinned (0 rows moved).

**H3: red before, green after, locally.** The dogfood shards skip on `pull_request` and `merge_group` (`ci.yml`, the `dogfood` job's `if:`), so this PR's CI will not run this test. These two local runs are the measurement of record. Both ran through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, with `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 test/authz-probe-blind-spot.test.ts`.

Before, on `fa6a6085c` (clean tree):

```text
 FAIL  |isolated| test/authz-probe-blind-spot.test.ts > authz probe blind-spot census (#13260) > packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts — every positive control is still present in THAT file
AssertionError: control "enforceAuth" moved in packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts: expected 64 to be 61 // Object.is equality
 ❯ test/authz-probe-blind-spot.test.ts:88:76
 Test Files  1 failed (1)
      Tests  1 failed | 46 passed (47)
os-verify-lock: VERDICT command-exit 1 · held the lock 3s · waited 0s
```

After, on `11d842198` (this PR's head):

```text
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  47 passed (47)
os-verify-lock: VERDICT command-exit 0 · held the lock 2s · waited 0s
```

**H4: the next move in flight. Measured, and it does not move this control.** At PR #23571's head `3dd76b2a8` (branch `claude/issue-23491-patch-data-request-gate`, merge base `086fa4640f`, which already contains `1d79556766`), the census reads `enforceAuth` 64, the same as the value re-anchored here. Its `rest-server.ts` diff (+41 / -17) adds and removes no line that spells the term. Every other control and figure on the row also reads as pinned there. That PR was not touched.

## Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `11d842198` derives 47 commands for the one changed path. All 47 ran locally, each recorded with its exit code captured before any pipe:

- 43 exited 0.
- 4 exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: they load built `dist/` across the workspace, and this worktree has no workspace build). These are NOT MEASURED locally: `check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure` and `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content`. CI's `Lint & Repo Gates` runs them.
- `--ran` reconciliation: `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 47 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 43 run, 4 NOT-MEASURED (4 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3).`

Declared narrowings:

- The dogfood package's full `pnpm test` (the three dogfood shards) was not run locally. The census module is imported by exactly one file, `test/authz-probe-blind-spot.test.ts` (`git grep`). That file was run in full, so the single-file run covers the whole reach of this diff.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood typecheck` is left to CI's `TypeScript Type Check`, whose PR selection includes the changed package. The edit is a numeric literal in the row's `controls` record (typed as a read-only record of string to number), plus comments. Building the dependency closure would mean 67 packages, 65 of them a turbo cache MISS on a dry run.

## Changeset

None. `@objectstack/dogfood` is `private: true`, so this diff publishes nothing from any released package. Under the repo's convention the PR carries the `skip-changeset` label.

## Acceptance notes

- Observation, not a defect: the census counts `enforceAuth` textually, comments included, by its own stated rule. Any prose mention added to `rest-server.ts` or `data-action-routes.ts` therefore moves the control. Because the dogfood shards skip on PRs and in the merge queue, only the hourly full run on `main` sees such a move. That is the two-speed design working as declared. Changing the counting rule is a census redesign, out of this card's scope. Carrier: none.
